How Tanay Kothari is rewriting how humans interact with machines:

Most voice AI is clunky, slow, and frustrating. Tanay didn’t just complain, he built a solution from scratch. He created @WisprFlow, a voice platform so fast, smart, and accurate that it makes Siri, ChatGPT, and Claude feel ancient.

He personally onboarded the first 500 users and convinced Marc Andreessen, Reid Hoffman, and Steve Wozniak to believe in his vision.

He tested it in every way possible: whispers, raps, gibberish, technical jargon, it got every word right. Wispr Flow went viral, reaching millions across X, LinkedIn, and Product Hunt, supporting 100+ languages, zero edits, sub-second responses.

Tanay raised $81M from top-tier VCs, built a team that could move as fast as his vision, and put Wispr Flow into the hands of Fortune 500s, indie developers, and innovators worldwide.

The lesson: Don’t wait for someone else to make the tools you need. If they don’t exist, create them yourself.

While others copy, Tanay builds. While others follow, he shapes the future.

Your voice is no longer just sound. It’s power. It’s creation. It’s your superpower.
